purpose: Bind the CMIX process-tree memory high-water to source-labelled allocation lifetimes and resident mappings before authorizing one probability-identical memory child.
dependencies: cmix_obias_memory_allocation_markers_q0_v1 source integration is materialized, reviewed, hashed, and compiled
allocation-marker parser passes fixed-record and lifetime checks
cmix memory phase-attribution observer is available
managed exclusive lease transition log and offline verification are terminally valid
Arm B terminal evidence is preserved before any execution

authority.successor_selection: only after a terminal valid receipt

collection_protocol.marker_transport: inherited pipe file descriptor in GAMMA_ALLOCATION_MARKER_FD
collection_protocol.marker_sequence_rule: strictly contiguous with no duplicate, gap, or reordering
collection_protocol.checkpoint_trigger: every new continuously sampled process-tree RSS maximum, every phase transition, and terminal cleanup
coherent_checkpoint: send SIGSTOP through pidfds to the codec process and every bound descendant
verify every PID and proc_start_ticks identity and wait until every target reports stopped
drain all complete marker records and record marker_sequence_before_checkpoint
capture process-tree status, codec maps, codec smaps, and page size
read the present and swapped bits for every fully contained usable-range page from /proc/<codec_pid>/pagemap
repeat the complete pagemap read without resuming the codec
drain markers again and require an unchanged marker sequence
send SIGCONT to exactly the stopped bound process set
collection_protocol.exact_allocation_lifetime_rule: An allocation is live at a checkpoint only when its allocation event precedes the checkpoint marker bound and no matching release precedes that bound.
collection_protocol.conservative_residency_rule: Credit only base pages whose complete byte range lies inside the marker usable range, lies inside an observed VMA, and has the pagemap present bit set in both stopped-process reads. The intersection is the resident lower bound; the union is the upper bound.
collection_protocol.partial_page_rule: The first or last page is excluded whenever any byte lies outside the usable range.
collection_protocol.vma_rule: VMA containment and smaps RSS are reconciliation evidence only and may never be assigned wholesale to an allocation label.
collection_protocol.ambiguous_window_rule: Any marker change while the process is declared stopped, PID identity change, pagemap short read, inaccessible pagemap, VMA mutation, or failed stop/resume operation invalidates that checkpoint.
collection_protocol.phase_source: explicit runner phase marker plus resource-guard phase state
collection_protocol.smaps_scope: codec process at every coherent attribution checkpoint; process-tree RSS remains the principal rule metric
collection_protocol.pagemap_scope: present and swapped bits only; PFNs are neither required nor retained
collection_protocol.observer_accounting: observer resource use and stop durations are reported separately; the diagnostic run has no runtime authority

mapping_contract.identity: device, inode, pathname, VMA start, VMA end, permissions, and offset
mapping_contract.rule: Marker allocation geometry must never be represented as VMA geometry, and VMA RSS must never be credited to a label. Only conservative pagemap page-range bounds are source-attributed.

corroborating_metrics: smaps mapping RSS at coherent stopped checkpoints
double-read pagemap lower and upper bounds over fully contained allocation pages
high_water_contract.selection_rule: A memory successor may be authorized from a coherent checkpoint lower bound, but only a later probability-identical child run can prove memory eligibility.

activation_requirements: a coherent checkpoint is triggered by a new continuous process-tree RSS maximum in the high-water phase
eligible live FXCM usable ranges have a conservative pagemap intersection lower bound of at least 1472880 KiB
file backing and pageout do not alter any modeled bytes
temporary-disk and cleanup ceilings remain feasible
successor_selection.if_requirements_fail: Do not activate file-backed FXCM; authorize one successor targeted at the largest exactly attributed eligible allocation family.
successor_selection.probability_identity_requirement: Any memory child must reproduce the parent integer probability stream, state hashes, payload, archive, and inverse before receiving memory credit.

invalidity_conditions: marker sequence gap, duplicate, or malformed record
required source label absent without an explicit not-allocated reason
codec PID or process start identity mismatch
checkpoint cannot be bound to an unchanged marker sequence while the codec process tree is stopped
pagemap is unavailable, short, changes mapping identity, or cannot be read twice
VMA RSS is represented as allocation-owned resident memory
continuous global high-water ownership is claimed from a diagnostic checkpoint
observer changes codec command, affinity, environment, input, scratch, or package
runtime conclusions drawn from the diagnostic run
terminal_outputs: managed lease transition-log, verification, and terminal-lease hashes
single authorized memory successor or none
